title: Study on the structure and properties of inclusion complexes of large ring cyclodextrin and aromatic compounds
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34039-34048
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03235K, Paper

Chuan Cao, Pingping Huang, Jing Guo, Deming Li
We successfully used co-precipitation to integrate four common aromatic compounds with different functional groups into macrocyclic dextrin, and we provided a detailed description of the inclusion complexes that occurred.
